channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: CCPC Takes 18 New Consumer Law Enforcement Actions Across Five Counties
item.description: CCPC takes 18 new enforcement actions nationwide, targeting influencers, retailers and pubs for consumer law breaches.

item.title: ⚠️ Yellow Low Temperature/Ice Warning Issued for Cork
item.description: Met Éireann has issued a Yellow - Low Temperature/Ice Warning for Cork. Valid: 21:00 Friday 13 February until 10:00 Saturday 14 February, further information will be issued shortly. Further information via met.ie.

item.title: Yellow Ice Warning Issued for CorK
item.description: Yellow ice warning issued for Cork and 28 counties, with frost and icy conditions expected from Friday night into Saturday morning. Take care on roads and footpaths.

item.title: Collision on N22 Lissarda
item.description: Reports of a collision on the N22 near Ballytrasna, Lissarda. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.

item.title: Breakdown on N40 Westbound
item.description: Reports of a breakdown, westbound, on the N40 South Ring Road between Jack Lynch Tunnel East Entrance and Jack Lynch Tunnel West Entrance (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 12 February at 12:00.

item.title: Féile Fearann Rí Returns to Cork’s Northside With Four Days of Traditional Music and Community Events
item.description: Féile Fearann Rí returns to Cork’s northside from 25–28 March with music, workshops and community events.

item.title: €13.4m Wastewater Treatment Plant Project Gets Underway in Castlemagner
item.description: €13.4m investment sees work begin on a new wastewater treatment plant in Castlemagner, boosting capacity, protecting waterways, and supporting future housing growth.

item.title: Norovirus Cases Rise Sharply as HSE Urges Public to Take Precautions
item.description: Norovirus cases have surged this winter. The HSE is urging people to stay home when unwell and follow hygiene advice to help protect others.

item.title: Night-Time Road Closures and Traffic Restrictions Planned on N20 for Abnormal Load Movement
item.description: Night-time delays expected on the N20 this weekend as an abnormal load travels through North Cork under Garda escort. Motorists advised to plan ahead.

item.title: Collision on Rochestown Road
item.description: Reports of a collision on Rochestown Road near Clarkes Hill. Take care on approach.
